label: Some concrete individual exists at w and at every world…, by Whole-roster-borrowing-cut-an…
meaning: Actual concrete population and the existing no-self-contained-borrowing cut yield source-backed actual concrete supply: apply the cut to the entire actual roster; a wholly external supplier is impossible because its contributors are nonempty. Compose the earlier supply/source extraction and contingent-root exclusion to derive necessary concrete existence. No necessary witness is assumed. The borrowing-cut application and contingent dependence remain substantive philosophical premises; this is their composed consequence, not an independent defense of either.
